445
446 /// Walk the parsed query AST and compute the total number of Field nodes
447 /// (complexity) and the maximum SelectionSet nesting depth.
448 struct QueryAnalysis {
449 uint32_t depth = 0;
450 uint32_t complexity = 0;
451 };
452
453 ✗ static QueryAnalysis analyse_query_complexity(const isched::v0_0_1::gql::TAstNodePtr& root) {
454 ✗ QueryAnalysis result{};
455 ✗ if (!root) return result;
456
457 // Plain recursive functor: no std::function overhead, no lambda captures.
458 struct Walker {
459 QueryAnalysis& r;
460 ✗ void operator()(const isched::v0_0_1::gql::TAstNodePtr& node,
461 uint32_t cur_depth) const {
462 ✗ if (!node) return;
463 ✗ const auto& t = node->type;
464 ✗ if (t.ends_with("gql::Field")) ++r.complexity;
465 ✗ if (t.ends_with("gql::SelectionSet")) {
466 ✗ const uint32_t next = cur_depth + 1;
467 ✗ if (next > r.depth) r.depth = next;
468 ✗ for (const auto& child : node->children) (*this)(child, next);
469 ✗ return;
470 }
471 ✗ for (const auto& child : node->children) (*this)(child, cur_depth);
472 }
473 };
474 ✗ Walker{result}(root, 0);
475 ✗ return result;
476 }
